summary:
Frontend-only verification of two requested fixes on /marketing (SocialStudio).

FIX A (Idioma del post on main form): PASS — lang-toggle is visible on the main post form right under brief-input (brief.bottom=1219px, lang.top=1282px). Exactly ONE lang-es and ONE lang-en exist in the DOM. Clicking lang-en activates the emerald highlight on EN and removes it from ES; clicking lang-es reverses it. Opening 'Más opciones' (more-options-btn) shows advanced-settings-drawer with ONLY 'Colores personalizados' inside — 0 lang-es and 0 lang-en within that drawer. Confirmed no duplicates and no requirement to open the drawer to choose language.

FIX B (idea → Crear imagen IA → Usar en Post preserves brief): PASS — From /marketing/inicio, clicking cat-trabajo_terminado loads 3 ideas; clicking idea-use-ai-0 navigated to /marketing?mode=ai&imgprompt=…&brief=… (both params present and Spanish-encoded). Clicked 'Crear imagen' to generate; the real Emergent-LLM AI image completed in ~12s; 'Usar en Post' became visible on the result card; clicking it switched to Imagen mode (mode-image active) and brief-input was PRE-FILLED with the original Spanish idea (168 chars, starts: 'Publica un carrusel mostrando el paquete final entregado al cliente (feed optimizado, calendario de contenido y 3 creati…'). A success toast 'Imagen lista en el Post ✨' appeared.

No critical console errors during either run (1 unrelated 404 for a resource — pre-existing, not from these fixes).
critical_code_review_comments: SocialStudio.js still ~1015 lines (carryover from iter_27/28). Consider extracting the Más opciones drawer, the result drawer, and the searchParams initial-state hydration into separate components for maintainability.
useAiImageInPost(file, preview) intentionally leaves brief untouched so a brief seeded via ?brief= (or already typed) is preserved — this is exactly what fixes B; good targeted change.

Idioma del post section is positioned between brief (#3) and Formato (#4) without a numeric label; minor UX nit — consider numbering it (e.g. '3b' or move to '4') so the numbered steps stay consecutive. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both FIX A and FIX B verified end-to-end (lang selector on main form + no duplicates + drawer cleaned; idea→AI→Usar en Post preserves Spanish brief).

seed_data_creation: None — used live LLM idea generation and live AI image generation (Emergent key).
context_for_next_testing_agent: On /marketing (Imagen mode), 'Idioma del post' is now rendered on the MAIN form between brief-input (#3) and Formato (#4) with data-testid='lang-toggle' wrapping data-testid='lang-es' and data-testid='lang-en'. The 'Más opciones' drawer (data-testid='advanced-settings-drawer', opened via data-testid='more-options-btn') now contains ONLY 'Colores personalizados' (custom-accent-input + custom-brand-input). MarketingStart.js openAi() navigates to /marketing?mode=ai&imgprompt=<image_prompt>&brief=<idea>. SocialStudio reads searchParams.brief into initial brief state and useAiImageInPost(file, preview) switches mode→'image' WITHOUT resetting brief, so any brief seeded from URL or typed text is preserved across the AI-generate → Usar en Post flow. AI image generation took ~12s in this run; allow up to 25-30s for variance.
rca of the issue: n/a — both fixes verified working as specified.
